It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 22, 2021}} The district comprises all twelve local government units in mainland Surigao del Norte including its capital [[Surigao City]]. Its municipalities are [[Alegria, Surigao del Norte|Alegria]], [[Bacuag]], [[Claver, Surigao del Norte|Claver]], [[Gigaquit]], [[Mainit, Surigao del Norte|Mainit]], [[Malimono]], [[Placer, Surigao del Norte|Placer]], [[San Francisco, Surigao del Norte|San Francisco]], [[Sison, Surigao del Norte|Sison]], [[Tagana-an]] and [[Tubod, Surigao del Norte|Tubod]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 22, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Bernadette Barbers]] of the [[Nacionalista Party]] (NP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 22, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
